main_text.p: יִרְבֶּה, ) fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. Rad. רָבָה.
יִרְבּוּ augescent, Deut. 8. 13. (pro יִרְבּוּ,) fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. רָבָה.
וַיִּרְבְּ[?] & multiplicabit te, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. רָבָה.
וַיִּרָּנוּ & murmurqverunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. רָנַן.
descendere, Infin. Kal, Rad. יָרַד.
וַיֹּרֶד & diduxit, fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. R. יָרַד.
וַיִּרְדֶּ[?] & dominabitur, (apoc. pro יִרְדֶה) fut. Kal, 3. s. m. Rad. רָדָה.
יֵרֵד dominabitur, (apoc. pro יִרְדֶּה,) fut. Piel, 3. s. m. Rad. רָדָה.
יָרֵד faciet dominari, (apoc. pro יִרְדֶּה,) fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. Rad. רָדָה.
וַיֹּרִיד & descendere fecit, fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. (pro יוֹרִיד,) Rad. יָרַד.
יֵרֵד descendet, fut. Kal, 3. s. m. R. יָרַד.
יָרֵד descendens, Ben. Kal, s. m. Rad. יָרַד.
וַיִּרְדָּה & dominatus est ei, fut. Kal, 3. s. m. יִרְדֶּה, aff. Rad. רָדָה.
וַיֹּרִידֵהוּ & descendere fecerunt eum, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. יָרַד.
יֹרִידֵהוּ descendere faciet eum, [?] eos, fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. aff. Rad. יָרַד.
יִרְדּוּ dominabuntur, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. רָדָה.
יֹרִידוּ descendere facient, pro יוֹרִידוּ) fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. Rad. יָרַד.
מִיֶּרֶד ex descendendo me, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. R. יָרַד.
וַיִּרְדֵּם & somno sopitus fuit, fut. Niph. 3. s. m. Rad. רָדַם.
יִרְדְּנוּ dominabitur ei (vi-ro)

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the gutter are faint; those marked [?] are uncertain. The symbol before "eos" in the entry "descendere faciet eum" is a damaged Hebrew suffix mark and is marked [?]. The last entry continues on the signature line with "ro)", read as the end of "(viro)".
